17402.commentary: (DNa) gāviṃ ekakhuraṃ katvā'ti gāviṃ gahetvā ekakhuraṃ vāhanam'eva katvā. taṃ abhiruyha vessavaṇassa paricārakā yakkhā… pasuṃ ekakhuraṃ katvā'ti ṭhapetvā gāviṃ avasesacatuppadajātikaṃ pasuṃ ekakhuraṃ vāhanam'eva katvā disodisaṃ anuyanti.

examples.text: gāviṃ ekakhuraṃ katvā, anuyanti disodisaṃ, pasuṃ ekakhuraṃ katvā, anuyanti disodisaṃ.

17403.meaning1: with the same destination; having an identical future existence

examples.text: (sabbe ekagatikā kātabbā).

n'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, aññaṃ ekagandham'pi samanupassāmi yaṃ evaṃ purisassa cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati yatha'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, itthigandho. itthigandho, bhikkhave, purisassa cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhatī'ti.

17406.meaning1: rule about going between villages alone

17408.meaning2: taking alms only from one house

17409.commentary: (SNPa) na'y'idaṃ ekaguṇaṃ mutan'ti tañ'ca idaṃ pāraṃ ekakkhattuṃ'y'eva phusan'āraham'pi na hoti. kasmā? ekena maggena sabbakilesappahān'ābhāvato. etena ekamaggen'eva arahatt'ābhāvaṃ dīpeti.

examples.text: ucc'āvacā hi paṭipadā, samaṇena pakāsitā, na pāraṃ diguṇaṃ yanti, na'y'idaṃ ekaguṇaṃ mutaṃ.

17411.commentary: (MNa) samāhitaṃ cittaṃ ek'aggan'ti cittam'pi me sammā āhitaṃ suṭṭhu ṭhapitaṃ appitaṃ viya ahosi. samāhitattā eva ca ek'aggaṃ acalaṃ nipphandanan'ti, ettāvatā jhānassa pubbabhāgapaṭipadā kathitā hoti.

examples.text: āraddhaṃ kho pana me brāhmaṇa vīriyaṃ ahosi asallīnaṃ upaṭṭhitā sati asammuṭṭhā passaddho kāyo asāraddho samāhitaṃ cittaṃ ek'aggaṃ
thaddha-visama-bhūmibhāgasmiñ'hi caṅkame caṅkamantassa pādā rujjanti, phoṭā uṭṭhahanti, cittaṃ ek'aggaṃ na labhati, kammaṭṭhānaṃ vipajjati.

… evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, appakā te sattā ye vavassagg'ārammaṇaṃ karitvā labhanti cittassa samādhiṃ labhanti cittass'ek'aggaṃ, atha kho et'eva sattā bahutarā ye vavassagg'ārammaṇaṃ karitvā na labhanti samādhiṃ na labhanti cittass'ek'aggaṃ.

17413.meaning1: with a unified mind; with a collected mind

examples.text: ye pana te kulaputtā… āraddhavīriyā pahit'attā upaṭṭhitassatino sampajānā samāhitā ek'aggacittā paññavanto aneḷamūgā, tehi bhavaṃ gotamo saddhiṃ saṃvasati.
so tāya samādhisampadāya attān'ukkaṃseti, paraṃ vambheti, aham'asmi samāhito ek'aggacitto, ime pan'aññe bhikkhū asamāhitā vibbhantacittā'ti.
saddhassa hi, bhante, ariyasāvakassa āraddhavīriyassa upaṭṭhitassatino etaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ yaṃ vossagg'ārammaṇaṃ karitvā labhissati samādhiṃ, labhissati cittassa ek'aggataṃ.
yā kho, āvuso visākha, cittassa ek'aggatā ayaṃ samādhi, cattāro satipaṭṭhānā samādhinimittā, cattāro sammappadhānā samādhiparikkhārā.
seyyathā'pi, bhante, selo pabbato acchiddo asusiro ekagghano. atha puratthimāya ce'pi disāya āgaccheyya bhusā vātavuṭṭhi n'eva naṃ saṅkampeyya na sampakampeyya na sampavedheyya
selo yathā ekagghano, vātena na samīrati, evaṃ rūpā rasā saddā, gandhā phassā ca kevalā, iṭṭhā dhammā aniṭṭhā ca, nappavedhenti tādino.
selo yathā ekaghano, vātena na samīrati, evaṃ nindāpasaṃsāsu, na samiñjanti paṇḍitā.

sekhassa, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno appattamānasassa anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ patthayamānassa viharato ajjhattikaṃ aṅgan'ti karitvā n'āññaṃ ek'aṅgam'pi samanupassāmi yaṃ evaṃ bah'ūpakāraṃ yatha'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, yoniso manasikāro.

17418.meaning1: seeing only one aspect; viewing from one angle
17418.meaning2: seeing only one part, one aspect
17418.commentary: (UDa) janā ek'aṅgadassino yath'eva jacc'andhajanā hatthissa ek'ek'aṅgadassino yaṃ yaṃ attanā phusitvā ñātaṃ, taṃ tadeva hatthī'ti gahetvā aññam'aññaṃ viggayha vivadiṃsu, evaṃsampadam'idan'ti attho. ivasaddo c'ettha luttaniddiṭṭho'ti veditabbo. (THa) ek'aṅgadassī dummedho'ti evaṃ anekaliṅge anekalakkhaṇe atthe yo tattha ek'aṅgadassī aputhupaññatāya ekaliṅgamattaṃ ekalakkhaṇamattañ'ca disvā attanā diṭṭham'eva idam'eva saccan'ti abhinivissa mogham'aññan'ti itaraṃ paṭikkhipati

examples.text: imesu kira sajjanti, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā, viggayha naṃ vivadanti, janā ek'aṅgadassino'ti.

17419.meaning2: deficient in one respect; lacking one attribute

17420.meaning1: one-eyed; half-sighted; with only material and no spiritual vision
17420.commentary: (MNt) paññācakkhunā diṭṭhadhammikassa samparāyikassa ca atthassa adassanato andho, diṭṭhadhammikass'eva dassanato ekacakkhu, dvinnam'pi dassanato dvicakkhu, veditabbo.

examples.text: katamo ca, bhikkhave, puggalo ekacakkhu? idha, bhikkhave, ekaccassa puggalassa tathārūpaṃ cakkhu hoti yathārūpena cakkhunā anadhigataṃ vā bhogaṃ adhigaccheyya adhigataṃ vā bhogaṃ phātiṃ kareyya, tathārūpaṃ pan'assa cakkhu na hoti yathārūpena cakkhunā kusal'ākusale dhamme jāneyya, sāvajj'ānavajje dhamme jāneyya, hīnappaṇīte dhamme jāneyya, kaṇhasukkasappaṭibhāge dhamme jāneyya.

ekacattālīsame vagge paṭham'āpadāne pabbhārakūṭaṃ nissāyā'ti-ādikaṃ tissametteyyattherassa apadānaṃ. tattha tāpasapabbajjaṃ pabbajitvā padum'uttarassa bhagavato ajinacammaṃ nisīdan'atthāya dinnam'eva nānaṃ.
2. akkharā'p'ādayo ekacattālīsaṃ.

17423.commentary: (SNa) sīhaṃ'v'ekacaraṃ nāgan'ti ekacaraṃ sīhaṃ viya, ekacaraṃ nāgaṃ viya. gaṇavāsino hi pamattā honti, ekacarā appamattā, tasmā ekacarāva gahitā'ti.

examples.text: dūraṅ'gamaṃ ekacaraṃ, asarīraṃ guh'āsayaṃ, ye cittaṃ saṃyamessanti, mokkhanti mārabandhanā.
eṇijaṅghaṃ kisaṃ vīraṃ, app'āhāraṃ alolupaṃ, sīhaṃ v'ekacaraṃ nāgaṃ, kāmesu anapekkhinaṃ, upasaṅkamma pucchāma, kathaṃ dukkhā pamuccatī'ti

17424.meaning1: living alone; solitude; being single; wandering alone

examples.text: carañ'ce n'ādhigaccheyya, seyyaṃ sadisam'attano, ekacariyaṃ daḷhaṃ kayirā, n'atthi bāle sahāyatā.
paṇḍito'ti samaññāto, ekacariyaṃ adhiṭṭhito, athā'pi methune yutto, mando'va parikissati.

17425.meaning2: going about or living alone, solitariness; solitary life; wandering alone

17426.commentary: (THa) eko'y'eva hutvā caraṇavasena pavattanato ekacāri, antamaso dve tīṇi'pi cittāni ekato uppajjituṃ samatthāni nāma n'atthi, ekam'eva pana cittaṃ ekasmiṃ santāne uppajjati. tasmiṃ niruddhe aparam'pi ekam'eva uppajjati, tasmā ekacāri.

examples.text: arūpa dūraṅ'gama ekacāri, na te karissaṃ vacanaṃ idāni'haṃ, dukkhā hi kāmā kaṭukā mahabbhayā, nibbānam'ev'ābhimano carissaṃ.
tesaṃ'y'eva dhammānan'ti tesaṃ maggasampayuttadhammānaṃ. āsevanā'ti-ādīsu ekacittakkhaṇikā'y'eva āsevan'ādayo vuttā'ti.

17428.meaning1: fact of lasting one mind moment
17428.construction:
eka + citta + khaṇika + tta
ekacittakkhaṇika + tta

examples.text: taṃ sandhāya sekhāya vijjāya pattabban'ti āha. maggassa pana ekacittakkhaṇikattā tattha ṭhitassa pucchā nāma n'atthi. iminā suttena maggo'pi bahucittakkhaṇiko hotū'ti ce.

maggo sañjāyatī'ti paṭhamo lok'uttaramaggo nibbattati. so taṃ magganti ekacittakkhaṇikamaggassa āsevan'ādīni nāma n'atthi, dutiyamagg'ādayo pana uppādento tam'eva āsevati bhāveti bahulīkarotī'ti vuccati.

17430.meaning1: wearing one robe; with an under-robe
17430.commentary: (SNa) ekacīvaro aṭṭhāsī'ti nivāsanaṃ nivāsetvā kāyabandhanaṃ bandhitvā cīvaraṃ hatthena gahetvā aṭṭhāsi. (VVa) ekacīvaro'ti nhāyitu'kāmo'ti adhippāyo.

examples.text: tap'ode gattāni parisiñcitvā paccuttaritvā ekacīvaro aṭṭhāsi gattāni pubb'āpayamāno.
tassa me anukampāya, nikkhipi pattacīvaraṃ, nisīdi rukkhamūlasmiṃ, chāyāya ekacīvaro.
evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco bhikkhu bhikkhusaṅghaṃ piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubandho hoti, aham'pi bhikkhu, aham'pi bhikkhū'ti.
idha, bhikkhave, ekaccassa puggalassa appamattakam'pi pāpakammaṃ kataṃ tam'enaṃ nirayaṃ upaneti.
katamā ca, sāriputta, opapātikā yoni? devā, nerayikā, ekacce ca manussā, ekacce ca vinipātikā, ayaṃ vuccati, sāriputta, opapātikā yoni.

ye'me, bho gotama, samaṇabrāhmaṇā saṅghino gaṇino gaṇ'ācariyā ñātā yasassino titthakarā sādhusammatā, bahujanassa… sabb'ete sakāya paṭiññāya abbhaññaṃsu sabb'eva n'ābbhaññaṃsu, udāhu ekacce abbhaññaṃsu ekacce n'ābbhaññaṃsū'ti?
puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, sappuriso sabbaso n'evasaññān'āsaññ'āyatanaṃ samatikkamma saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ upasampajja viharati. paññāya c'assa disvā ekacce āsavā parikkhīṇā honti.

17434.meaning1: believing in the non-eternality of some things; professing partial non-eternalism

examples.text: santi, bhikkhave, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā ekaccasassatikā ekacca-asassatikā ekaccaṃ sassataṃ ekaccaṃ asassataṃ attānañ'ca lokañ'ca paññapenti catūhi vatthūhi.

17435.meaning1: doctrine of partial eternalism; view that some things are eternal
17435.commentary: (DNt) te pana yasmā ekaccasassato vādo diṭṭhi etesan'ti ekaccasassatavādā nāma honti, tasmā tam'atthaṃ dassento āha ekaccasassatavādā'ti.

17436.meaning1: believing in the eternality of some things; professing partial eternalism
17436.commentary: (DNa) ekaccasassatikā'ti ekaccasassatavādā. te duvidhā honti, satt'ekaccasassatikā, saṅkhār'ekaccasassatikā'ti. duvidhā'pi idha gahitā'y'eva.

examples.text: dutiye ca bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā kim'āgamma kim'ārabbha ekaccasassatikā ekacca-asassatikā ekaccaṃ sassataṃ ekaccaṃ asassataṃ attānañ'ca lokañ'ca paññapenti?
saccaṃ kir'evam'āhaṃsu, narā ekacciyā idha, kaṭṭhaṃ niplavitaṃ seyyo, na tv'ev'ekacciyo naro'ti.

17439.grammar: ind, adv, comp, loc sg of ekacchanna
17439.meaning1: under the same roof; in the same room

examples.text: saha vā seyyaṃ kappeyyā'ti ekacchanne ukkhittake nipanne bhikkhu nipajjati, āpatti pācittiyassa. bhikkhu nipanne ukkhittako nipajjati, āpatti pācittiyassa. ubho vā nipajjanti, āpatti pācittiyassa.
khippataraṃ kho so, bhikkhave, kāṇo kacchapo amusmiṃ ekacchiggale yuge gīvaṃ paveseyya, ato dullabhatarāhaṃ, bhikkhave, manussattaṃ vadāmi sakiṃ vinipātagatena bālena. taṃ kissa hetu?
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, ayaṃ mahāpathavī ek'odakā assa. tatra puriso ekacchiggaḷaṃ yugaṃ pakkhipeyya.

17444.meaning1: once born; live-born (not from an egg)

examples.text: ekajaṃ vā dvijaṃ vā'pi, yo'dha pāṇaṃ vihiṃsati, yassa pāṇe dayā n'atthi, taṃ jaññā vasalo iti.

17445.meaning2: single mass of flames; being a single mass of flames

17446.meaning1: having one and the same mode of life

examples.text: bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāsājīvasamāpanno'ti yā bhikkhūnaṃ adhisīlasaṅkhātā sikkhā, tañ'ca, yattha c'ete saha jīvanti ekajīvikā sabhāgavuttino honti, taṃ bhagavatā paññattasikkhāpadasaṅkhātaṃ sājīvañ'ca tattha sikkhanabhāvena samāpanno'ti bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāsājīvasamāpanno.

17447.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of ekadhā
17447.meaning1: together; in one place; in the same place
17447.construction:
eka + dhā + ya + aṃ
ekajjha + aṃ

examples.text: evañ'ca pana, bhikkhave, vūpasametabbaṃ. sabbeh'eva ekajjhaṃ sannipatitabbaṃ, sannipatitvā byattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena saṅgho ñāpetabbo.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso yaṃ imasmiṃ jambudīpe tiṇakaṭṭhasākhāpalāsaṃ tacchetvā ekajjhaṃ saṃhareyya, ekajjhaṃ saṃharitvā sūlaṃ kareyya
yo sahassaṃ sahassena, saṅgāme mānuse jine, ekañ'ca jeyya'm'attānaṃ, sa ve saṅgāmaj'uttamo, attā have jitaṃ seyyo, yā c'āyaṃ itarā pajā.
nānā hi kho no, bhante, kāyā ekañ'ca pana maññe cittan'ti

17449.meaning1: just one; only one; merely a single

examples.text: ekaññ'eva nu kho, bhante, bhagavā saññ'aggaṃ paññapeti, udāhu puthū'pi saññ'agge paññapetī'ti? ekam'pi kho ahaṃ, poṭṭhapāda, saññ'aggaṃ paññapemi, puthū'pi saññ'agge paññapemī'ti.
assadamakena, bhikkhave, assadammo sārito ekaññ'eva disaṃ dhāvati, puratthimaṃ vā pacchimaṃ vā uttaraṃ vā dakkhiṇaṃ vā.
ekañ'hi saccaṃ na dutīyam'atthi, yasmiṃ pajā no vivade pajānaṃ, nānā te saccāni sayaṃ thunanti, tasmā na ekaṃ samaṇā vadanti.

17451.commentary: (THIa) tadekaṭṭhe ca āsave'ti rāgadosehi sahaj'ekaṭṭhe pahān'ekaṭṭhe ca

examples.text: sikkhamānā ahaṃ santī, bhāventī maggam'añjasaṃ, pahāsiṃ rāgadosañ'ca, tadekaṭṭhe ca āsave.
na vissase ekatiyesu evaṃ, agārisu pabbajitesu c'āpi, sādhū'pi hutvā na asādhu honti, asādhu hutvā puna sādhu honti.

17456.commentary: (THa) ekatiṃse ito kappe'ti-ādi. ito bhaddakappato uddhaṃ ārohanavasena ekatiṃse kappe.

examples.text: ito so, bhikkhave, ekatiṃse kappe yaṃ sikhī bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho loke udapādi. tasmiññ'eva kho, bhikkhave, ekatiṃse kappe vessabhū bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho loke udapādi.
ekatiṃse ito kappe, yaṃ saññamalabhiṃ tadā, tassā saññāya vāhasā, patto me āsavakkhayo'ti.

17460.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of eka

examples.text: idha, bhante, koci'd'eva dhammo samuppādo uppajjeyya, ekato assa bhagavā ekato bhikkhusaṅgho ca. yen'eva bhagavā ten'ev'āhaṃ assaṃ, evaṃ pasannaṃ maṃ, bhante, bhagavā dhāretu
na ukkhittakāya antaraghare gantabbaṃ. yo anādariyaṃ paṭicca ekato vā ubhato vā ukkhipitvā antaraghare gacchati, āpatti dukkaṭassa.

17461.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of eka

examples.text: saddhin'ti ekato.

ayaṃ pan'ettha saṅkhepo, bhagavato kira bhikkhusaṅghassa ca pañcannaṃ mahānadīnaṃ mah'oghasadise lābhasakkāre uppanne hatalābhasakkārā aññatitthiyā sūriy'uggamanakāle khajjopanakā viya nippabhā hutvā ekato sannipatitvā mantayiṃsu.

17462.meaning1: one having lust; one being aroused
17462.commentary: (KVt) ekatoavassute'ti bhikkhuniyā avassave, bhikkhuniyā kāyasaṃsaggarāgena avassutabhāve satī'ti attho. bhikkhuniyā vasen'eva ca ekatoavassutabhāvo gahetabbo.

17464.commentary: (VINa) ekato-upasampannāyā'ti ettha bhikkhunīnaṃ santike ekato-upasampannāya, yo garudhammena ovadati, tassa dukkaṭaṃ. bhikkhūnaṃ santike upasampannāya pana yathāvatthukam'eva.

examples.text: ovadeyyā'ti aṭṭhahi garudhammehi ovadati, āpatti pācittiyassa. aññena dhammena ovadati, āpatti dukkaṭassa. ekato-upasampannaṃ ovadati, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
nisīdanapaccattharaṇaṃ dhovāpeti, āpatti dukkaṭassa. ekato-upasampannāya dhovāpeti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.

17465.meaning2: carrying pole with a load at one end

17466.meaning1: sharpened on one side; single-edged; single-bladed

examples.text: satthaṃ nāma ekatodhāraṃ ubhatodhāraṃ paharaṇaṃ.

17467.meaning1: siding with one faction; of one group

examples.text: ath'āparesaṃ ekatopakkhikānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ byattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena sako pakkho ñāpetabbo.

ath'āparesaṃ ekatopakkhikānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ yaṃ bhikkhuṃ suvacataraṃ maññeyyātha so upasaṅkamitvā evam'assa vacanīyo, āyasmantānaṃ kho atthato c'eva nānaṃ, byañjanato ca nānaṃ. tadaminā'p'etaṃ āyasmanto jānātha, yathā atthato c'eva nānaṃ, byañjanato ca nānaṃ.

17468.meaning2: garland with stalks on one side

17469.commentary: (MNa) ekatte'ti ekībhāve. kiṃ dasseti? kāyaviveke kate'pi tattha cittaṃ abhiramāpetuṃ dukkaraṃ. dvayaṃdvay'ārāmo hi ayaṃ loko'ti

examples.text: ek'āsanassa sikkhetha, samaṇ'ūpāsanassa ca, ekattaṃ monam'akkhātaṃ, eko ce abhiramissasi, atha bhāhisi dasadisā.
durabhisambhavāni hi kho, bho gotama, araññavanapatthāni pantāni sen'āsanāni, dukkaraṃ pavivekaṃ, durabhiramaṃ ekatte, haranti maññe mano vanāni samādhiṃ alabhamānassa bhikkhuno'ti.
ekattaṃ ekattato sañjānāti, ekattaṃ ekattato saññatvā ekattaṃ maññati, ekattasmiṃ maññati, ekattato maññati, ekattaṃ me'ti maññati, ekattaṃ abhinandati. taṃ kissa hetu? apariññātaṃ tassā'ti vadāmi.
chinda sotaṃ parakkamma, kāme panūda brāhmaṇa, nappahāya munī kāme, n'ekattam'upapajjati.

17471.commentary: (SNa) ekattan'ti jhānaṃ. idaṃ vuttaṃ hoti, kāme ajahitvā muni jhānaṃ na upapajjati, na paṭilabhatī'ti attho.

examples.text: chinda sotaṃ parakkamma, kāme panuda brāhmaṇa, nappahāya munī kāme, n'ekattam'upapajjati.

17472.commentary: (MNa) ekattā ekattasitā'ti catutthajjhān'upekkhā, sā hi divasam'pi ekasmiṃ ārammaṇe uppajjanato ekasabhāvā, tadeva ekaṃ ārammaṇaṃ nissitattā ekattasitā nāma.

examples.text: evam'etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya disvā y'āyaṃ upekkhā nānattā nānattasitā taṃ abhinivajjetvā, y'āyaṃ upekkhā ekattā ekattasitā yattha sabbaso lok'āmis'ūpādānā aparisesā nirujjhanti tam'ev'ūpekkhaṃ bhāveti.

atthi, bhikkhave, upekkhā ākās'ānañc'āyatananissitā, atthi viññāṇ'añc'āyatananissitā, atthi ākiñcaññ'āyatananissitā, atthi n'evasaññān'āsaññ'āyatananissitā, ayaṃ, bhikkhave, upekkhā ekattā ekattasitā.
321, 349. diguss'ekattaṃ.
digussa samāsassa ekattaṃ hoti, napuṃsakaliṅgattañ'ca.
atha kho, bhante, brahmā sanaṅkumāro ekattena attānaṃ upasaṃharati, ekattena attānaṃ upasaṃharitvā sakkassa devānam'indassa pallaṅke pallaṅkena nisīditvā deve tāvatiṃse āmantesi

17476.meaning1: physically identical; with one type of body
17476.meaning2: having bodies of the same nature, having uniform bodies
17476.commentary: (DNa) Iti sabbe'pi te ekattakāyā c'eva catutthajjhānasaññāya ekattasaññino cā'ti veditabbā.

examples.text: sant'ānanda, sattā ekattakāyā ekattasaññino, seyyathā'pi devā subhakiṇhā. ayaṃ catutthī viññāṇaṭṭhiti.

17477.meaning1: enjoying solitude; taking pleasure in seclusion
17477.meaning2: devoted to (or devotion to) solitariness or unity
17477.commentary: (THa) idaṃ vuttaṃ hoti, imasmiṃ araññe viravahetu sippik'ābhirutahetu viya, pāpima, tava vissarakaraṇahetu mama cittaṃ kammaṭṭhānato na paripatatī'ti. tattha kāraṇam'āha ekattaniratañhi me'ti.

examples.text: cihacih'ābhinadite, sippik'ābhirutehi ca, na me taṃ phandati cittaṃ, ekattanirataṃ hi me'ti.

yā vā pan'etāsaṃ saññānaṃ parisuddhā paramā aggā anuttariyā akkhāyati, yadi rūpasaññānaṃ yadi arūpasaññānaṃ yadi ekattasaññānaṃ yadi nānattasaññānaṃ. n'atthi kiñcī'ti ākiñcaññ'āyatanam'eke abhivadanti appamāṇaṃ āneñjaṃ.

17479.meaning1: having a single perception; (or) percipient of unity
17479.meaning2: having a notion of unity or identity
17479.commentary: (DNa) iti te kāyassa nānattā, paṭhamajjhānavasena saññāya ekattā nānattakāyā ekattasaññino'ti veditabbā.

examples.text: ekattasaññī attā ca loko ca, idam'eva saccaṃ mogham'aññan'ti, itth'eke abhivadanti, nānattasaññī attā ca loko ca, idam'eva saccaṃ mogham'aññan'ti, itth'eke abhivadanti

17480.meaning1: having identical perception; with the same single conception
17480.meaning2: having perceptions or notions of the same nature

examples.text: ekattasaññiṃ vā te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā saññiṃ attānaṃ paññapenti arogaṃ paraṃ maraṇā, nānattasaññiṃ vā te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā saññiṃ attānaṃ paññapenti arogaṃ paraṃ maraṇā

17481.meaning1: based on unity; based on a single object
17481.commentary: (MNa) ekattā ekattasitā'ti catutthajjhān'upekkhā, sā hi divasam'pi ekasmiṃ ārammaṇe uppajjanato ekasabhāvā, tadeva ekaṃ ārammaṇaṃ nissitattā ekattasitā nāma.

examples.text: evam'etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya disvā y'āyaṃ upekkhā nānattā nānattasitā taṃ abhinivajjetvā, y'āyaṃ upekkhā ekattā ekattasitā yattha sabbaso lok'āmis'ūpādānā aparisesā nirujjhanti tam'ev'ūpekkhaṃ bhāveti.

atthi, bhikkhave, upekkhā ākās'ānañc'āyatananissitā, atthi viññāṇ'añc'āyatananissitā, atthi ākiñcaññ'āyatananissitā, atthi n'evasaññān'āsaññ'āyatananissitā, ayaṃ, bhikkhave, upekkhā ekattā ekattasitā.

17487.meaning1: having one meaning; singular in meaning
17487.commentary: (MNa) ek'atthā'ti ārammaṇavasena ek'atthā. appamāṇaṃ ākiñcaññaṃ suññataṃ animittan'ti hi sabbānetāni nibbānass'eva nāmāni. iti iminā pariyāyena ek'atthā.

examples.text: yā c'āyaṃ, āvuso, appamāṇā cetovimutti, yā ca ākiñcaññā cetovimutti, yā ca suññatā cetovimutti, yā ca animittā cetovimutti, ime dhammā nān'ātthā c'eva nānābyañjanā ca udāhu ek'atthā byañjanam'eva nānan'ti?
atthi kho, āvuso, pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma ime dhammā nān'ātthā c'eva nānābyañjanā ca, atthi ca kho, āvuso, pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma ime dhammā ek'atthā, byañjanam'eva nānaṃ.

17488.meaning1: on one sheet; using a single cover

examples.text: te kul'itthīhi kuladhītāhi kulakumārīhi kulasuṇhāhi kuladāsīhi saddhiṃ ekabhājane'pi bhuñjanti, ekathālake'pi pivanti, ek'āsane'pi nisīdanti, ekamañce'pi tuvaṭṭenti, ek'attharaṇā'pi tuvaṭṭenti, ekapāvuraṇā'pi tuvaṭṭenti, ek'attharaṇapāvuraṇā'pi tuvaṭṭenti

17489.meaning1: rule about lying on the same sheet

17490.meaning1: on one sheet and under one cover; using a single sheet and blanket
17490.commentary: (VINa) ekaṃ attharaṇañ'c'eva pāvuraṇañ'ca etāsan'ti ekattharaṇapāvuraṇā, saṃhārimānaṃ pāvār'attharaṇa-kaṭasārak'ādīnaṃ ekaṃ antaṃ attharitvā ekaṃ pārupitvā tuvaṭṭentīnam'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ.

examples.text: te kul'itthīhi kuladhītāhi kulakumārīhi kulasuṇhāhi kuladāsīhi saddhiṃ ekabhājane'pi bhuñjanti, ekathālake'pi pivanti, ek'āsane'pi nisīdanti, ekamañce'pi tuvaṭṭenti, ek'attharaṇā'pi tuvaṭṭenti, ekapāvuraṇā'pi tuvaṭṭenti, ek'attharaṇapāvuraṇā'pi tuvaṭṭenti

17491.meaning1: perceiving (someone) as on one sheet and under one cover

examples.text: te kul'itthīhi kuladhītāhi kulakumārīhi kulasuṇhāhi kuladāsīhi saddhiṃ ekabhājane'pi bhuñjanti, ekathālake'pi pivanti, ek'āsane'pi nisīdanti, ekamañce'pi tuvaṭṭenti, ek'attharaṇā'pi tuvaṭṭenti, ekapāvuraṇā'pi tuvaṭṭenti, ek'attharaṇapāvuraṇā'pi tuvaṭṭenti

17493.meaning1: one day; sometimes; at some (unspecified) time

examples.text: ko nu kho, bho gotama, hetu, ko paccayo yen'ekadā dīgharattaṃ sajjhāyakatā'pi mantā nappaṭibhanti, pag'eva asajjhāyakatā?
laddhā hi so upādānaṃ, mahā hutvāna pāvako, so āsajja ḍahe bālaṃ, naraṃ nāriñ'ca ekadā.
ucc'āvacehi vaṇṇehi, urago carati tejasī, so āsajja ḍaṃse bālaṃ, naraṃ nāriñ'ca ekadā, tasmā taṃ parivajjeyya, rakkhaṃ jīvitam'attano.
kathañ'hi nāma ekadāsikāya divā uṭṭhāsī'ti kupitā anattamanā aggaḷasūciṃ gahetvā sīse pahāraṃ dassati, sīsaṃ vobhindissatī'ti.

na gocarakusalo hotī'ti gopālakena hi gocarakusalena bhavitabbaṃ, pañc'āhikavāro vā satt'āhikavāro vā jānitabbo, ekadisāya gogaṇaṃ cāretvā punadivase tattha na cāretabbo. mahatā hi gogaṇena ciṇṇaṭṭhānaṃ bheritalaṃ viya suddhaṃ hoti nittiṇaṃ, udakam'pi āluḷīyati.
upasaṅkamitvā bhagavato sarīraṃ naccehi gītehi vāditehi mālehi gandhehi sakkarontā garuṃ karontā mānentā pūjentā celavitānāni karontā maṇḍalamāḷe paṭiyādentā ekadivasaṃ vītināmesuṃ.
yaṃnūn'āhaṃ yaṃ me tīhi māsehi dātabbaṃ siyā taṃ sabbaṃ ekadivasen'eva dadeyyan'ti

17498.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of ekadivasa

examples.text: aparaṃ pana ekadivasaṃ uyyānaṃ gacchanto tath'eva devatāhi nimmitaṃ sunivatthaṃ supārutaṃ pabbajitaṃ disvā, ko nām'eso sammā'ti sārathiṃ pucchi.

17499.meaning1: in just one day; all at once

examples.text: yaṃnūn'āhaṃ yaṃ me tīhi māsehi dātabbaṃ siyā taṃ sabbaṃ ekadivasen'eva dadeyyan'ti
